headline: Carleton finishes MIAC play unbeaten
dek: Carleton allowed only ten goals across the entire season while scoring 47, winning fourteen matches against just two defeats and three draws. Every setback came against non-conference opposition, and the season closed with Carleton still unbeaten inside the league.
